itens.t: North Korea fires salvo of around 10 ballistic missiles toward sea, says Seoul

Seoul's Joint Chiefs of Staff stated they are closely monitoring the situation in coordination with US intelligence. itens.t: SpaceX fires up Starship upper stage ahead of landmark Flight 15 test launch

itens.d:
SpaceX conducted static-fire tests with its Starship Ship upper stage, known as Ship 42, in preparation for the upcoming Flight 15 test launch. The vehicle performed a full-duration six-engine static fire and a single Raptor engine test to simulate a deorbit burn.

Following successful static fires of both the upper stage and the Super Heavy booster, CEO Elon Musk targets a November launch. SpaceX plans to attempt catching both the Ship and Super Heavy using the launch tower chopstick arms.

itens.t: Astronomers discover possible new dwarf planet beyond Neptune
itens.r: Using the Vera Rubin Observatory, astronomers have identified a mysterious icy object orbiting the sun in the distant reaches beyond Neptune. Designated 2026 ED138, the object measures up to 1,500 kilometers across and could be classified as a dwarf planet.
itens.d:
Astronomers discovered a possible new dwarf planet circling the sun beyond Neptune using the Vera Rubin Observatory. The icy object, named 2026 ED138, is estimated to be between 600 and 1500 kilometers wide and large enough to form a sphere under its own gravity.

The object was found by Matthew Holman from the Center for Astrophysics when running previously collected data through a search code developed with Kevin Napier.
